You ''sure'' it's him?|The Glymphid|The human traveling with the ''Millennium Falcon,'' pale hair, low intelligence--|Luke Skywalker|Hey!|The Glymphid|--answers to the name of Luke.|Han Solo|That's you all right, kid.|attr=The Glymphid and Han Solo about Luke Skywalker|src=<ref name="Uprising" />}}
A '''Glymphid''' tracked down the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyemari]] to deliver a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] from [[Rezi Soresh]]. He had been promised a large reward to deliver the message. The Rebels forced him to stay while they played the message and planned on questioning him afterward. This [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] using a time-released [[Poison/Legends|poison]] in front of Skywalker to demonstrate Soresh's reach.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I been looking for you for a long time. And it's worth a big reward for me if you just listen to this message.|The Glymphid to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Uprising" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] was in [[Anem]], the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Nyemari]]. He was looking for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], as a reward had been promised if he delivered a message to Skywalker. While Skywalker and his [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|companions]] were conducting a [[Mission to Nyemari|mission]], this Glymphid visited the [[South Anem Spaceport]] and met the [[Nyemarian]] mechanic [[Li Preni]]. Preni informed the Glymphid the Rebels were in town. After the mission, the Rebels returned to the South Anem [[Spaceport/Legends|Spaceport]] and met Preni themselves, who told them someone was following them. The Nyemarian lied about saying anything, but told the Rebels about the Glymphid when [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] threatened him. Thinking the alien was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]], Solo wanted to seek him out and deliver his own message to Jabba. Solo convinced his companions to join him.<ref name="Uprising" />

The Rebels left the spaceport and went back into Anem to seek out the Glymphid. The Glymphid seemed to stay one step ahead of them before the Rebels cornered him in a dusty, disused [[plaza]] in Anem. The Glymphid informed them that he had "found" them. He stepped toward the assembled Rebels, only to stop when they all raised their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] at him. He told them to stop, informing them he had a message. Solo was confused as to why Jabba would have sent him a message, but the alien informed him the message was for Skywalker. Pulling out a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], he described Skywalker, and then gave him a [[holochip]] and [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoplayer]]. While the other Rebels debated whether to play the message, Solo grabbed it himself and started the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]].<ref name="Uprising" />

The message was from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Rezi Soresh]]. As Soresh introduced himself to Skywalker, the Glymphid backed away, but Solo stopped him, telling him to stick around and answer their questions. Soresh continued his message, saying he had business to conduct with Skywalker. He informed the pilot he had captured the [[Endeavor (Arkanian starship)|colony vessel ''Endeavor'']], and was using the 100 people on board to as hostages to draw Skywalker to his [[Unidentified dead red moon|outpost]]. Skywalker had twelve hours to present himself, and Soresh said he was watching him, and would provide a demonstration.<ref name="Uprising" />

The Glymphid started screaming, then collapsed in front of Skywalker, and finally expired from some sort of activated [[Poison/Legends|poison]]. Skywalker wanted to leave to go to Soresh, but his companions would not let him go alone. They left to go meet Soresh and were all [[Battle of the Sixela system|captured]].<ref name="Uprising" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Not so fast buddy. How 'bout you stick around while we watch this. Then you're going to answer all our questions.''"<br />"''I don't know anything, I swear.|Han Solo to the Glymphid|<ref name="Uprising" />}}
The Glymphid searched for Skywalker to receive a reward. He tried to back away when the Rebels were distracted, and he expressed fear when threatened by Solo, stuttering that he did not know anything.<ref name="Uprising" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Glymphid appears in [[Alex Wheeler]]'s [[2010]] book ''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''.<ref name="Uprising" />
